$comment: Task 34: dedicated bee / owl / apiary art. The atlases have NO image files of their own: their pixels are painted at runtime by apps/client/src/task34-art.ts (software rasterizer -> blob URL, the vehicles/atlas.ts pattern) and the sources override in view.ts points the registry at those blob URLs, so the `image`/`ktx2` paths below are never fetched. They point at real pack atlases (items_build for the 64px creatures, nature_icons for the 128px Apiary, which is 512x256 like it) only because the pack test requires every manifest atlas to name a PNG + KTX2 twin that exist on disk. Atlas layout is a plain grid (frame() math): 8 direction rows x 4 frames per animation, idle rows 0-7, walk rows 8-15, dirStride = columns = 8. The Apiary is a 4x2 grid: row 0 = rotation 0, row 1 = rotation 1, 4 damage stages per row, rotationArt mirror (rot 2/3 mirror rows 0/1).
